summary: Standard chess vs Stockfish (3600) where SCP-956, the pinata, hides on an empty square and reveals itself only to bonk every adjacent pawn (both colours) with a bat; each bonked pawn adds another hidden pinata, and the pinatas vanish once no pawns are left. Game 1 (0:17-4:19): pawns disappear in cascades, won with king and rook. Game 2 (4:44-8:56): attempted 'cheese' (queen on a4 lined up on the king through d7) fails, won with king and rook again. Game 3 (8:59-9:37): Qa4 then Qe4 behind e5; the pinata removes the pawn and the queen takes the king.
rules: Standard chess, you are White, Stockfish (3600) is Black (0:17, maxres2).
One hidden pinata starts on one of the unoccupied squares (0:17).
It only targets pawns, of both colours (0:35; bonks c5 1:15, a7+b7 1:29, a2+b2 1:31, e4/d2/c2 1:42).
It reveals itself only to bonk every pawn adjacent to it (8 neighbours) (0:01, 6:39 'A7 and B7 get removed. C4 gets removed as well').
For every pawn bonked, one more hidden pinata is added (0:09, 1:15, 6:18).
A square next to a pawn cannot hold an undiscovered pinata, so the 3rd and 6th ranks are ruled out from the start (5:32-5:47).
If a piece lands directly on a pinata, the pinata repositions somewhere else on the board (6:07-6:18).
When all pawns are gone, the pinatas are gone for the rest of the game (2:36).
A bonk can expose a king; the queen lined up through one pawn then takes it (4:50, 9:10-9:37 'the king is looking directly at us').
win_condition: Checkmate, or capture a king left exposed by a bonk.
rounds: 3 games, all won by the creator (two king-and-rook mates, one king capture through the cheese).

effects_and_pacing: The pinata appears on its square over the board (maxres2); pawns are removed one after another (6:39: a7, then b7, then c4). No frame of the hit itself is available.
inferred: Start pinata: uniform over empty squares that touch no pawn.

A new pinata from a bonk hides on a random empty square that touches no pawn (5:32-5:47: an undiscovered pinata is never next to a pawn; uniform spawning made a single bonk chain through all 16 pawns in testing, which the video never shows). A repositioned pinata goes to any random empty square and bonks at once if it touches a pawn (6:07-6:18, f4 -> h6, g7+h7).
Bonks resolve after every move (both sides); several pinatas act in square order, pawns one at a time, 8-neighbour order clockwise from the top-left.
Bat swing, knock-off and candy burst animation are our staging.
